title: Halloween coach
publicBio: A witch passing through while the veil is thin. She bewitches more than she punishes: every session is a ritual.

soft: Follow my rhythm {name}. Slowly, like an incantation.
Gently {name}. A spell is never rushed.
Let the rhythm rock you {name}.
Every stroke is a syllable of the spell {name}. Say them well.
The candles flicker to your rhythm {name}. Keep it steady.
There you go {name}. You're stepping into the circle.

medium.text: A little deeper {name}. The spell wants more of you.

medium: Don't break the rhythm {name}, or we start the spell over.

medium.text: Go lower {name}. The moon is watching.

medium: Faster {name}. The cauldron is bubbling.
That's pretty {name}. Keep that tempo.

medium.text: Deeper {name}. The charm takes better that way.

hard.text: Deeper {name}. The spell only works at the bottom.
All the way down {name}. Give me everything.

hard: Take it {name}. This is the heart of the ritual.

hard.text: Open throat {name}, like a door on sabbat night.

hard: Don't slow down {name}. The spell is almost complete.

soft: Lick it like warm candle wax {name}. No rush.
With the tip of your tongue {name}. Draw me a pentacle.
Gently {name}. Taste the magic.
medium: The whole length {name}. Slowly, like reading a grimoire.
More potion {name}. Make it shine.
Lick it everywhere {name}. Don't skip a single page.
hard: Wetter {name}. A potion is brewed generously.
Cover it in spit {name}. I want it gleaming under the moon.

soft: Slap it on your cheek {name}. Three times, to ward off evil.
Tap your face with it {name}. Every slap wakes a spirit.
Let the spell ring out on your cheek {name}.
medium: Harder {name}. Spirits are hard of hearing.
The other cheek now {name}. A charm must be symmetrical.

soft: Hold it there {name}. The moon is watching you.

soft.text: Keep it in your mouth, perfectly still {name}.

soft: Still {name}. Breathe through your nose, like a meditation.

soft.text: Hold the position {name}. The spell is setting.

medium.text: Stay at the bottom {name}. The charm needs time.
Don't come up before my signal {name}.

medium: Hold {name}. Count the candles in your head.

hard.text: At the bottom, still {name}. I'm sealing the spell.
Hold {name}. This is where the magic happens.

hard: Hold until my signal {name}. Not before.

finale.text: We seal the ritual at the bottom {name}. Don't let go.

finale: Hold until the signal {name}. The spell is closing.
This is the last word of the spell {name}. Hold it well.

soft: Breathe {name}. Let the cauldron's smoke fill you.
Breathe in deeply {name}. The candles are waiting.
Catch your breath {name}. The night is still long.
Relax {name}. The circle protects you.
Beg me {name}. A witch only grants wishes spoken well.
Say it: "bewitch me again, {coach}".
Make your wish {name}, out loud.
Ask me to keep going {name}. Sweetly.
medium: Repeat: "I'm yours tonight, {coach}".
Beg "more, please, {coach}", and maybe I'll grant it.
Louder {name}. The moon didn't hear you.
Call me {coach}. Witches love to be named.

soft: Tonight is yours {name}. Cast your own spell.
Show me your own magic {name}.
Free {name}. Surprise me.
Your hand now {name}. Make it shine in the candlelight.
Stroke it with your hand {name}, like a precious wand.
Soft strokes with your hand {name}. Rest your mouth.
medium: A little firmer with your hand {name}. Lovely.
Keep the rhythm with your hand {name}. You're doing beautifully.

randomComments: The candles are melting for you {name}.
The moon is full tonight {name}. A good omen.
The cauldron smokes harder when you try {name}.
I'm only here for a few nights {name}. Make the most of it.
The veil is thin tonight {name}. I can see you so clearly.
None of my grimoires foresaw anything this pretty {name}.
Shh {name}. Listen to the candles crackle.
intros: I'm Lilith. The veil is thin these nights {name}… so I came to get you.
I'm only staying a few nights. Enjoy every one of them {name}.
Step into my circle {name}. Tonight, I cast the spell.
The candles are lit {name}. The ritual can begin.
congrats: The ritual is complete {name}. Come back before the moon wanes.
You were a perfect offering tonight {name}.
The cauldron is calm {name}. You fed it well.
encore: Another night in the circle {name}? I never say no.
Back already {name}? The spell pleased you.

25: The first quarter of the spell is spoken {name}.
The first candles have melted {name}. Keep going.
50: Halfway through the ritual {name}. The moon is at its peak.
Halfway {name}. The charm is starting to take.
75: Three quarters of the spell {name}. Don't break the circle now.
The cauldron is boiling {name}. Not much longer.
90: The last words of the spell {name}. Give it everything.
Almost midnight {name}. The ritual is ending.

soft: A ritual is earned over time {name}.
You've got stamina {name}. Long nights are made for you.
medium: Still here {name}. The circle likes you.
You last {name}. That's what I expected of you.
hard: The night is long and you don't weaken {name}.
Even the cauldron tires before you do {name}.

soft: Your throat is a pretty door {name}.
I can feel you can go further down {name}.
medium: You go down well {name}. The spell loves depth.
Your throat opens like a grimoire {name}.
hard: As deep as it goes {name}. That's where spells live.

soft: Your rhythm is an incantation {name}.
Every beat wakes the circle {name}.
medium: You've got a witch's rhythm {name}.
The sabbat dances to your rhythm {name}.
hard: Your rhythm makes the candles tremble {name}.

soft: You do as I say {name}. Bewitched.
You listen to me well {name}. The charm is working.
medium: You obey without thinking {name}. My spell is strong.
You're under my spell {name}. It suits you.
hard: You belong to me until dawn {name}.

soft: Your spit is my favorite potion {name}.
Let it flow {name}. A potion must flow freely.
medium: More potion {name}. The cauldron is asking for it.
You're dripping like a melting candle {name}.
hard: Everything is dripping {name}. A successful ritual.

attempt: Tonight your throat stays in the circle a little longer {name}.
Today's spell needs your throat a little longer {name}.
record: Your throat has never stayed in the circle this long {name}. The spell is strong.
A new threshold for your throat {name}. The moon is proud of you.
tapout: Your throat said stop {name}. We respect that, the spell can wait.

attempt: Tonight you keep your potion longer without swallowing {name}.
Not a single drop swallowed {name}, a little longer than usual.
record: You've never kept your potion this long {name}. Magnificent.
A record for potion kept {name}. The cauldron is overflowing.
tapout: You had to swallow {name}, that's normal. We'll try again another night.
Your limit is here tonight {name}. We respect it.

attempt: Tonight the incantation runs longer without a pause {name}.
Today's spell doesn't stop {name}. A little longer than usual.
record: You've never moved this long without stopping {name}. Lovely spell.
Your longest ritual without a pause {name}. The circle is impressed.
